'''Burr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition|coalition]] along with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. There Burr engaged in a conversation with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Stroh]] of the Republic, a man who under normal circumstances would be his enemy.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Burr appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
